Find the players nobody's watching.

OpenScout ranks and filters under-the-radar talent for clubs that scout on a budget. Start by telling it who you scout for — then every player gets a Fit score tuned to your division, budget and needs.

…or just explore with a plain-English search:

⚑ Demo dataset: 5014 real players — from Europe's top flights down to 5th-tier and B / reserve sides across ~180 clubs, spanning 60+ nationalities and all positions, live-verified for the 2025-26 season from public sources. This is the engine — a real deployment plugs in a live data feed or your own scouting entries. Set up your club for tailored Fit scores, or add players / import a CSV to grow the pool. Set up your club

Tell OpenScout who you're scouting for. Every player's Match score becomes a Fit score — tuned to your division, budget and squad needs. Nothing is sent anywhere; it saves to this browser only.

Value for money — how hard to weigh the fee against your budget & what the player brings

Needs a transfer budget above. A cheap, proven target scores a Good value bonus; a pricey player who eats your budget without the pedigree gets docked. Free agents count as a €0 fee.

Positions you need — click to add; first pick is your priority
Home-grown nationality to prioritise — optional (quota help)

A player a level above you is marked harder to attract; one over budget is penalised instead of rewarded for a high value. See the exact math in any player's "why this score".
